newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentine commission to probe IBM contracts.
newsitem.headline: Argentine commission to probe IBM contracts.

text.p: The lower house of Argentine Congress on Friday named a commission to investigate contracts between International Business Machines Corp (IBM) and state entities, the state-owned Telam news agency reported.
IBM's Argentine unit is at the center of a series of scandals including allegations that bribes were paid to clinch a $250 million contract with the state-owned Banco Nacion.
In September, a judge confirmed that 11 people, including the former heads of Banco Nacion and IBM Argentina, were indicted in connection with the contract.
The eight-member commission named by Chamber of Deputies President Alberto Pierri includes four members of the governing Peronist Party and four opposition members.
